item.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the continuation of the Central Sector Scheme “Postal Operations” during the 16th Finance Commission Cycle from FY 202
item.title: Cabinet approves continuation of Postal Operations Scheme with an outlay of Rs. 1,141 Crore for 16th Finance Commission Cycle (FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31)
